verdict.rationale: Reducto's docs confirm dedicated table extraction with configurable output formats (HTML/markdown) as part of Parse, but none of the evidence explicitly addresses merged cells, nested headers, or tables spanning multiple pages — the specific fidelity challenges named in the story. Community commentary (Mathpix founder comparison, struggles reported on 300+ page documents) raises general accuracy concerns but doesn't concretely confirm or deny complex-table structural fidelity. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or examples of merged-cell/nested-header handling, evidence of multi-page table stitching, and independent benchmark/hands-on validation of structural accuracy on complex tables.
